name: maestro-mcp
description: MCP server for Maestro plugin - provides advanced orchestration and multi-branch session capabilities

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all available sub-agents with their descriptions and capabilities

search.description: Search agents by name or description

tools.name: get_agent_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific sub-agent

tools.name: analyze_task
tools.description: Analyze a task and recommend appropriate sub-agents

tools.name: execute_workflow
tools.description: Execute a defined workflow with multiple sub-agents

workflow.description: Workflow definition in YAML or JSON format

variables.description: Variables to pass to the workflow

tools.name: get_execution_status
tools.description: Get the status of a running or completed execution

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Get execution metrics and statistics

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Get synchronization status for all configured platforms

tools.name: sync_push
tools.description: Push CDD tracks to external platforms

platform.description: Target platform (clickup, linear, jira, asana, todoist, youtrack, notion, github)

trackId.description: Specific track ID to push (optional, pushes all if omitted)

tools.name: sync_pull
tools.description: Pull items from external platforms to CDD

tools.name: sync_link
tools.description: Link a CDD track to an external platform item

tools.name: sync_test
tools.description: Test connection to external platforms

platform.description: Platform to test (optional, tests all if omitted)

tools.name: sync_config
tools.description: Get or update sync configuration

tools.name: complete_execution
tools.description: Complete a workflow execution and run post-execution hooks

tools.name: cdd_activate
tools.description: Activate CDD mode with full Knowledge System initialization. Call this when /maestro:cdd is invoked to properly initialize the learning session.

branch.description: Git branch name (auto-detected if not provided)

tools.name: learning_init
tools.description: Initialize a learning session for the Context-Aware Learning System

branch.description: Git branch name for the learning session

tools.name: learning_finalize
tools.description: Finalize the current learning session and persist all learnings

tools.name: learning_status
tools.description: Get the current learning session status and summary

tools.name: learning_capture
tools.description: Capture a decision, research finding, or discovery

data.description: Learning data (title, description, rationale, context, etc.)

tools.name: learning_get_knowledge
tools.description: Get relevant knowledge for a task context

tools.name: learning_phase_complete
tools.description: Handle phase completion and summarize phase learnings

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health status of the Maestro system including knowledge store, sync engine, and learning session

tools.name: kb_backup
tools.description: Backup the knowledge store to a portable JSON file

outputPath.description: Path for the backup file (defaults to maestro/backups/)

includeIndex.description: Include the search index in backup

tools.name: kb_restore
tools.description: Restore the knowledge store from a backup file

branch.description: Branch to restore to (defaults to original branch)

merge.description: Merge with existing knowledge instead of replacing

tools.name: generate_diagram
tools.description: Generate a Mermaid diagram from tracks and their dependencies

trackId.description: Specific track to diagram (optional, diagrams all if omitted)

tools.name: hydrate_knowledge
tools.description: Hydrate knowledge system from git history. Extracts decisions, patterns, entities, learnings, and optionally generates feature documentation and ADRs.

mode.description: Hydration mode: full (all history), incremental (since last hydration), preview (dry run)

since.description: Start date or commit hash for filtering (ISO date or git ref)

until.description: End date or commit hash for filtering (ISO date or git ref)

maxCommits.description: Limit the number of commits to process

includeGitHub.description: Fetch and analyze GitHub PR data (requires GITHUB_TOKEN)

dryRun.description: Preview what would be extracted without saving

repos.description: Specific repositories to process (for multi-repo workspaces)

createTracks.description: Create retrospective tracks from merged branches

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for extracted knowledge (0-1)

groupBy.description: How to group commits into features: ticket (by JIRA/GitHub IDs), branch (by feature branches), scope (by conventional commit scope), semantic (by content similarity), auto (combine all strategies)

generateAdrs.description: Generate Architecture Decision Records in maestro/decisions/

trackDependencies.description: Track package.json/requirements.txt changes and detect technology decisions

analyzeStructure.description: Analyze directory structure changes for architectural insights

tools.name: generate_feature_docs
tools.description: Generate feature documentation from git history without full hydration. Groups commits and creates Markdown feature docs.

since.description: Start date for commit filtering (ISO date)

until.description: End date for commit filtering (ISO date)

maxCommits.description: Limit number of commits to process

minGroupSize.description: Minimum commits required to form a feature group (default: 1)

includeUngrouped.description: Include ungrouped commits in documentation (default: true)

tools.name: generate_adrs
tools.description: Detect and generate Architecture Decision Records from git history. Analyzes commits for architectural decisions and creates ADR documents.

since.description: Start date for commit filtering (ISO date)

until.description: End date for commit filtering (ISO date)

maxCommits.description: Limit number of commits to process

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for ADR detection (0-1, default: 0.6)

includeDependencyChanges.description: Include major dependency changes as ADRs (default: true)

includeStructureChanges.description: Include significant structure changes as ADRs (default: true)

tools.name: hydrate_status
tools.description: Get hydration status and progress. Shows whether the repository has been hydrated, last hydration time, and statistics.

resources.name: Agent Registry
resources.description: The complete registry of available sub-agents

resources.name: Sync Status
resources.description: Current synchronization status for all platforms

resources.name: Sync Links
resources.description: Mappings between CDD tracks and external platform items

resources.name: Learning Status
resources.description: Current learning session status and summary

resources.name: Knowledge Store
resources.description: Accumulated knowledge from the learning system

prompts.name: orchestrate
prompts.description: Orchestrate a complex task with Maestro

prompts.name: create_workflow
prompts.description: Create a new workflow from a task description

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: Description of the workflow to create
